scope: Machine-specific Unity MCP installation for the current reconstruction project; no credentials or per-instance bearer tokens are stored here.

cli.version_scope: Observed installation version; MSIX or Unity Hub updates can change the installed CLI later.

pipeline.server_scope: Editor-only local HTTP service with per-instance authentication; no Player service is enabled by this setup.

mcp.existing_chat_catalog_reload: A configured server is not proof that its tools have loaded into an already running chat; reload the MCP connection or start a fresh session.
